name: dispatch-handoff-execution
objective: Close the governed order path from offer through accept/decline, store arrival and bilateral custody to legal pickup/reassignment with cross-surface readback.
truthOwner: DSH owns assignment, delivery lifecycle, store↔Captain custody and operational exceptions; surfaces render and issue authorized commands only.

tasks.currentProblem: Dispatch Product Truth is implemented-pending-verification and requires one active assignment, expiry, actor-scoped decision, idempotency, service area/capacity and atomic reassignment.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace offer inbox/UI through dispatch API, backend, contracts and persistence; repair any mismatch in reason/deadline, decline reason, stale/late decisions, duplicate assignment, reassignment or operator readback.
tasks.targetState: Every offer and decision is authoritative, retry-safe and isolated; client sees only tracking state while operator sees governed decisions.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not allow two active assignments for one order.
Do not expose operator eligibility details to app-client.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept/decline applies only to authenticated assigned Captain and decline requires reason.
Assignment creation/reassignment is idempotent and concurrency-safe.
Operator and client readbacks reflect the same DSH assignment state with role-appropriate fields.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U004 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close bilateral store↔Captain custody before pickup
tasks.currentProblem: Handoff Product Truth requires partner confirmation and Captain completion before picked_up; open blocking exceptions and superseded assignments must prevent pickup.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace store arrival/custody creation, partner confirmation, Captain pickup, handoff shortage/mismatch, operator resolution and client order readback; fix any local-only or non-idempotent state.
tasks.targetState: Pickup can occur only after valid bilateral custody; exceptions persist across restart and resolution re-enables only legal continuation.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not mark picked_up from local UI state.
Do not mutate WLT because of custody exceptions.
Do not keep superseded custody executable after reassignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner and Captain confirmations are independently audited and idempotent.
Blocking mismatch/shortage prevents illegal pickup until governed resolution.
Refresh/restart and all affected surfaces read the same custody/exception state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U004 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.
